entries.title: Crewmate answers reach the first mate while work continues
entries.body: The first mate now tracks responses to its messages unless it explicitly asks for no answer. Submitted answers stay saved through later progress, restarts and task closure. If a crewmate reads a request but finishes its turn without responding, the first mate hears what is missing.
entries.noPicture: This repairs durable answer delivery between agents without changing a screen or control.
